newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine peso ends marginally down in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Philippine peso ends marginally down in dull trade.

text.p: The Philippine peso closed marginally lower at 26.287 to a dollar from Friday's close of 26.286 after drifting within a narrow range throughout the tepid session, traders said.
"There was no major flow to affect the movement of the peso," one trader said. Oil companies, which are regular buyers of the U.S. currency, bought only $11 million at 26.287.
The peso fluctuated within a narrow range of 26.282 and 26.288.
The Central Bank was a minor player during the day, buying about $8 million at 26.285. It had set its selling rate at 26.290 earlier in the day and adjusted it to 26.292 when the rate reached 26.288.
"It was a very boring day," another trader said. Turnover was modest with only $115.5 million changing hands.
Traders expected the peso to remain range bound for the rest of the week due to the absence of any major demand or inflows.
